Sansa Tamakawa.name: Sansa Tamakawa
Sansa Tamakawa.basicInfo:
Sansa Tamakawa, a police officer and Detective Naomasa Tsukauchi's usual partner on Quirk cases; between cases he takes statements at the Front Desk. A cat-headed heteromorph of average build: ginger tabby fur, yellow eyes, a white muzzle, a gold bell at his collar; a pale-blue police shirt and dark vest.
Speaking Style: Courteous and straightforward: clear questions, plain answers.
Combat Role: Not a frontline fighter; he secures scenes and radios for heroes.
Under Pressure: Falls back on procedure: secure the scene, protect civilians, call it in.
Sansa Tamakawa.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: The most unusual-looking officer in any room is the most devoted to ordinary procedure. Connections: Naomasa Tsukauchi, the detective he works beside, whose calm he matches. Knowledge: Police files, statements and whatever Tsukauchi shares. Canon voice & behavior: Courteous with witnesses; writes down what he sees and hears. Thread: Whether careful police work still counts in a city that calls heroes first.
QUIRK: Heteromorph: a cat's head. He uses no power on duty.
personality: Procedural: Ties every step of a case to the evidence in hand.
Patient: Lets nervous witnesses give statements at their own pace.
Supportive: Backs up colleagues and civilians on the practical steps.
Speaking style: Courteous, straightforward professional exchanges.
abilities: Police work: Scenes, statements, evidence and custody paperwork, by the book; he cuffs villains once a hero has them down.
Fighting style: Avoids fighting: holds the cordon and gets civilians clear.
Sansa Tamakawa.visualDescription: A man of average build with a cat's head: ginger tabby fur with darker stripes across the brow and cheeks, large yellow eyes, a white muzzle, pointed ears and long whiskers, and a small gold bell at his collar. He wears a pale-blue police shirt under a dark protective vest, dark uniform trousers and a duty belt with a radio. Calm, attentive expression.
